LETTER OF INTENT 
 This Letter of Intent (the “ L OI ” ) is entered into at Lahore on this ___ day of _________ 20___ by and between: 
 
 Zameen Crest ( SMC- Private) Limited , a company registered under the laws of Pakistan, with its registered office at Ground Floor, Mega Tower, 63-B, Main Boulevard, Main Gulberg, Lahore acting through its authorised representative Mr. A rman Yousuf (“ DEVELOPER ” which expression shall, where the context so admits, mean and include successors-in-interest and permitted assigns ).

 _____________________________________ s/o, d/o, w/o __________________________________ , having CNIC No. _______________________________ , resident of ________________________________________________________________________________________ (“ INTENDING PARTY ” , which expression shall, where the context so admits, mean and include successors-in-interest and permitted assigns ) . 
 AND 
 _____________________________________ s/o, d/o, w/o __________________________________ , having CNIC No. _______________________________ , resident of ________________________________________________________________________________________ (“ INTENDING PARTY No.2 ”, which expression shall, where the context so admits, mean and include successors-in-interest and permitted assigns ) . 
 AND 
 ________________________________ ____________ _______ a partnership/company/sole proprietor registered under the laws of Pakistan and having its registered office at ____________________________________________ ____________________________________________ through its authorised representative ___________ __ ____________________________ s/o, d/o, w/o __________________________________, having CNIC No. ______________________ ________ , resident of ________________________________________________________________________________________ (“ INTENDING PARTY ”, which expression shall, where the context so admits, mean and include successors-in-interest and permitted assigns ) . 
 [Each is individually a “ Party ” and, collectively, the “Parties ”] 
 WHEREAS 
 The Developer plans to develop and sell a real estate project named and styled as “ ZAMEEN VAULT ” comprising one ( 1) tower consisting of 2B+G+37 floors and based on an area of 21.39 Kanals and located at Plot No. B-24-01, Silicon IT District Block, NSIT City, Lahore (“ Project ”); and 
 The Intending Party has deposited a Preliminary Deposit as specified herein as a formal intent to purchase the unit (s) specified in Annexure A (“ Unit (s) ”) as per the terms a nd conditions of this LOI . 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree to the following terms and conditions: 
 SCOPE 
 
 The Intending Party is executing this LOI to formally record its intention to purchase the Unit(s) within the Project as specified in Annexure A, in accordance with the terms and conditions set forth herein. For the purpose hereof, the Intending Party shall remit a preliminary deposit (“ Preliminary Deposit ”) equivalent to _____________________________ percent ( ____ %) of the total sale consideration (“ Purchase Price ”), exclusive of all applicable taxes. The Unit(s) are being offered at a discounted rate, which is duly reflected in the Purchase Price as specified in Annexure A. 
 
 TERMS 
 
 The Intending Party hereby confirms the payment of the Preliminary Deposit in the amount of PKR ______________ _ /- ( _____ _______________________________________________________________) directly to the Developer, and the Developer hereby acknowledges receipt of the same. 
 
 The Developer undertakes to commercially launch the Project by 31 st July 2025 . The period commencing from the date of signing of this LOI until the commercial launch of the project shall be referred to as the “Lock-In Period” (“ Lock-In Period ”). During the Lock-In Period, the Intending Party understands and agrees that it cannot assign any obligations or benefits arising under this LOI to any third party. For the avoidance of doubt, the term commercial launch herein refers to the commencement of marketing and sales of the Project to the general public. 
 
 Upon the commercial launch of the Project, the Intending Party shall submit this LOI to the Developer and proceed to execute an agreement to sell (“ Agreement to Sel l”) in respect of the Unit with the Developer on the same terms outlined herein. 
 
 After the execution of the Agreement to Sell, the Intending Party may assign any obligations or benefits arising under this LOI to any third party. However, the Intending Party shall not sell, transfer, or otherwise dispose of the Unit(s) at a price lower than PKR ______________ /- per square foot. 
 
 The Intending Party understands and acknowledges that the Purchase Price is based on the floor area of the Unit(s) as specified in Annexure A. The Intending Party further acknowledges that the floor area mentioned within the floor plan of the Unit(s) in Annexure A is subject to variation of up to fifteen percent (15%). In the event of any such variation, the Purchase Price shall be adjusted proportionately based on the revised area at the time of executing the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 T he Intending Party shall be obligated to pay the remaining Purchase Price in accordance with the payment terms outlined in the Agreement to Sell . 
 
 Upon execution of this LOI, the Developer shall offer monthly payments (“ Monthly Payments ”), such as cashback, to the Intending Party in line with the terms and conditions outlined herein . This promotional offer will remain valid for three (3) years, starting thirty (30) days after the Preliminary Deposit is received in clear funds in the Developer’s account. The Monthly Payments will accrue until the later of the expiry of the Lock-In Period or the execution of the Agreement to Sell . Once the Agreement to Sell is executed , the accrued payments shall be disbursed, and the Monthly Payments shall continue to be paid in equal instalments . For the purpose of this offer, the Monthly Payments shall be calculated as a percentage of the Purchase Price of the Unit, as detailed in Annexure A. 
 
 The Developer hereby undertakes and agrees to buy back the Unit in the event that, upon the expiry of three (3) years from the date of execution of the Agreement to Sell, the selling price of the Unit is less than PKR ______________________ /- per square foo t. The Developer shall complete the buyback transaction within six (6) months from such determination. 
 
 In the event the Developer fails to commercially launch the Project within three (3) months after the expiry of the Lock-In Period, the Parties shall engage in good faith negotiations and make all reasonable efforts to amicably resolve the matter within two (2) months . If the matter remains unresolved upon the lapse of this period, the Developer shall be obligated to refund the Preliminary Deposit , along with the accrued Monthly Payments , to the Intending Party in full, without any deductions whatsoever, within two (2) months from the expiration of the aforementioned period. 
 
 In the event the Intending Party fails to execute the Agreement to Sell within thirty ( 30 ) days after the commercial launch of the Project , the Parties shall engage in good faith negotiations and make all reasonable efforts to amicably resolve the matter within fifteen ( 15 ) days. If the matter remains unresolved upon the lapse of this period, the Developer shall , upon the written request of the Intending Party, process the refund of the Preliminary Deposit after deducting a cancellation charge of an amount equivalent to twenty percent ( 20 %) of the Purchase Price. The balance amount of the Preliminary Deposit, after the permissible deduction, shall be refunded to the Intending Party within ninety ( 90 ) days from the expiration of the aforeme ntioned period. 
 
 Prior to the lapse of the Lock-in Period, the LOI can be terminat ed only through the mutual consent of both P arties, in writing, in accordance with the terms and conditions mutually agreed upon between the Parties. 
 
 REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES 
 
 Each Party represents and warrants that: 
 
 It has full legal authority to enter into and perform its obligations under this LOI ; and 
 
 The execution and delivery of this LOI do not violate any existing legal obligations, agreements, or laws applicable to the Party. 
 
 GENERAL CLAUSES 
 
 The Parties agree to keep the terms of this LOI and any related information confidential and not to disclose such information to any third party without prior written consent, except as required by law or regulatory authorities. 
 
 This LOI does not create any rights, title, or interests of any kind over the Unit(s) in favour of the Intending Party until the execution of the Agreement to Sell, except to the extent specified in this LOI. 
 
 This LOI shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Pakistan. 
 
 Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this LOI shall be resolved amicably through mutual consultation. If unresolved, the dispute shall be referred to arbitration under the Arbitration Act of 1940, with the seat of arbitration in Lahore. The decision of the arbitrator shall be final and binding on the Parties. 
 
 This LOI constitutes the entire understanding between the Parties concerning the subject matter and supersedes all prior discussions, negotiations, or agreements. 
 
 No amendments or modifications to this LOI shall be made except otherwise in writing and signed by both Parties. 
 
 The Intending Party may not assign or transfer its rights or obligations under this LOI without the prior written consent of the Developer, except as provided in Clause 2. 3. 
 
 Neither Party shall be held liable for any failure or delay in performance due to events beyond its reasonable control, including but not limited to natural disasters, wars, strikes, or governmental actions. 
 
 If any provision of this LOI is deemed invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect. 
 
 All notices under this LOI shall be in writing and delivered to the addresses specified above, either by hand, courier or registered mail. 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have executed this LOI , having fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.
